summary: Read-only recon of the pi-scholar review pipeline. Learn's blocking point is `await withReview(... reviewLearnDraft)` at tool-controller.ts:787; `deferCommit` only skips the in-handle `commitLesson` so the controller can run the crew. Approval is the newest per-role `ReviewReceipt` in `section.learnQuality.reviews`, written inside `mutateBook` at tool-controller.ts:795-796; `commitLesson` (lesson.ts:288-293) is the sole writer of `lessonCommit` and re-verifies via `learnReviewIssues`. reviewOne (review-layer.ts:175) is per-packet; runReviewPass aggregates per role. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the '12-minute shared review deadline' and '20-minute total work limit' no longer exist in code; README:56 and docs/architecture.md:45 say there is no wall-clock stop, and the only deadline is the reviewer run itself (REVIEW_BACKSTOP_MS = 45 min). Count rails 8/250/4 are live. Author feedback travels only through returned tool-result content (findings appended with result.content.push), plus the sticky stopDelivery latch that makes later tool results error.

files.description: Single writer of approvals/receipts; Learn/Tutor/Exam review orchestration, checkpoints, count rails, stop latch
Learn crew planning (planReviewAssignments), shared deadline, reviewCheckpoint, reviewLearnDraft reuse
reviewOne, ReviewPacket/Evidence, runReviewPass, aggregateReviews, per-mode planners, reviewTargetQuestion
Bounded isolated reviewer run, DEFAULT_REVIEWER_LIMITS, stall/backstop timeouts, transport safety
Receipt/finding/verdict shapes, reviewGateIssues, reviewPassIssues, pruneReviewReceipts, computeFindingKey
lessonHash/learnReviewHash/commitHash, commitLesson, learnReviewIssues, lessonReady, LessonCommit shape
handleNotes writes drafts and defers commitLesson when deferCommit; returns author-visible progress text
mutateBook: serialized per-vault/book atomic persistence path used by every receipt/approval write
Stored state shapes: learnQuality.reviews, tutor/exam review.receipts, lessonCommit, earnedDelivery
pi.sendMessage injection, review progress/UI reporting, input lock ownership
Extension event wiring: input handling, ctx.abort interrupts, agent_settled budget reset
Editor lock; Esc/app.interrupt routes to ctx.abort

architecture: tool-controller `scholar` action=notes -> handleNotes saves draft (commitLesson skipped when deferCommit) -> control returns to tool-controller -> withReview(reviewLearnDraft|runReviewPass) blocks inside the tool call -> receipts written back via mutateBook -> learnReviewIssues/reviewPassIssues decides -> commitLesson + recomputeProgress. Reviewers are isolated bounded registry calls (review-runtime) with readiness-gated roles: Learn [source,teaching,visual], Tutor [teaching], Exam [assessment,teaching], questions via reviewTargetQuestion([assessment]). Receipts are content-hash and source-hash bound and model-stamped; reuse is by newest per role plus per-packet batch cache.
report:
All anchors on C:/Users/basam/.pi/agent/extensions/scholar.

=== 1. LEARN CONTROL FLOW (scholar notes -> commitLesson) ===
1. `pi.registerTool` execute (tool-controller.ts:543; `executionMode:"sequential"` :540) -> `action==="notes"` (:670).
2. `deferCommit` (:672) = `active && (fresh || active.learnQuality || params.sourceCoverage)` where `active` is the Learn section (undefined in tutor/exam) and `fresh` = not complete, no lessonCommit, no saved lesson (:671). So tutor/exam never defer here.
3. `handleNotes(..., deferCommit)` (:691). Inside handleNotes: the mutation writes all fields into the section via mutateBook (learning.ts:117-188); the ONLY commit point is `if (params.lessonComplete && !deferCommit) commitLesson(section, state)` (learning.ts:186). With deferCommit the draft is persisted but NOT committed; the tool result text says "Draft saved; independent review pending." (learning.ts:193).
4. Tutor-only branch at :692-750 runs before the Learn path (see 6).
5. Learn path gates on `if (!deferCommit || !params.lessonComplete) return saved;` (:751) -> reload draft (:752-753) -> `hash = learnReviewHash(section)` (:754) -> pre-review coverage gate `lessonCoverageIssues` (:755-764): throws "Repair these delivery gaps..."; on the 4th rejection (MAX_PREREVIEW_REJECTIONS, :87) `stopDelivery` + throw.
6. Reuse fast-path: `targetKey = lesson:${section.id}`; if `passCompleted(targetKey)` (:762) it runs only `learnReviewIssues` inside mutateBook (:763-775); empty gaps -> `commitLesson` + `recomputeProgress` (:773); non-empty -> "blocking findings require responses" review result (:777-778). No crew is run.
7. Blocking point: `markPassCompleted` (:784); `reviewTimeoutMs = DEFAULT_REVIEWER_LIMITS.timeoutMs` (:785); `saveReviewCheckpoints` (:786); `const reviews = await withReview(... reviewLearnDraft(...), ...).finally(() => checkpoints.close())` (:787-788). The author agent is blocked here for the whole crew run because the tool result has not returned and the tool is sequential; `withReview` (defined :166-186) additionally aborts on activation/vault/authority change and re-asserts fresh source (:176-182).
8. Approval write: `mutateBook(draft.id, ...)` (:789-800) revalidates `learnReviewHash(current)===hash` + source hash (:791), asserts figure coverage, then `current.learnQuality!.reviews = pruneReviewReceipts([...reviews], {sourceHash, model: reviewerModelName(ctx)})` (:795-796) -> `gaps = learnReviewIssues(...)` (:797) -> if empty `commitLesson(current, state); recomputeProgress(state, current)` (:798).
9. Failure outcome: `final.result.length` -> "Draft saved; specialist review found repairs ... [F-<key>]" or "review incomplete (...)" (:803-807) with findings appended (:808-819); execution failures call `stopDelivery` (:818-820). Success -> "Full lesson committed after source, teaching and visual review..." (:822).
SINGLE-WRITER FUNCTIONS: `mutateBook` (book-service.ts:126-186: per-vault+book promise queue, atomic `ports.save` with expectedRevision) is the only persistence path. All receipt/approval writes are tool-controller closures: Learn :795-796, Tutor :727-728, Exam :894-895, checkpoint :204-205. `commitLesson` (lesson.ts:288-293) is the only writer of `section.lessonCommit`. `recomputeProgress` (domain.ts:230-234) is the only writer of `learnQuality.earnedDelivery` and `section.status`. No review module writes state.

=== 2. PER-PACKET VERDICT PATH ===
- `reviewOne(options: ReviewRunnerOptions, role?: ReviewRole, question?: {value, sourcePages}): Promise<ReviewReceipt>` review-layer.ts:175-179.
- Callers: `runReviewPass` worker (review-layer.ts:~500, retry-once at :527-529), `reviewTargetQuestion` (review-layer.ts:615, retry-once twice then throws at :640-652), tests.
- Packet: `ReviewPacket = { role; id; instruction; reads:number[]; views:number[]; cropIds:string[]; payload:Record<string,unknown> }` review-layer.ts:29-37. Tutor packet planTutorExplanationPacket :599-613; Exam planExamReviewPackets :557-597; Learn planReviewAssignments learn-review.ts:62-163.
- Evidence: `ReviewEvidence { read(start,end); view(page); crop(id) }` :39-43; `createReviewEvidence` :46-65 (read=extractSourcePages bounded, view=renderPdfPage, crop=safePathWithinRoot + sha256 re-check). `currentReviewSnapshots` :68-73.
- Verdict/finding/failure/receipt/receipt-batch TS shapes: learn-quality.ts:149-173 (`ReviewFinding{severity,target,sourcePages,issue,repair}` :149-155; `ReviewResult{status,findings}` :156; `ReviewerVerdict` :157; `ReviewFailure{code,message}` :158-159; `ReviewBatchPass{key,findings}` :165; `ReviewReceipt = ReviewResult & {role,contentHash,sourceHash,model,createdAt,failure?,batches?,diagnostics?}` :166-173). `isReviewFinding` :175-182; `isReviewReceipt` :364-379.
- Verdict construction: `receipt(verdict)` review-layer.ts:194-206 stamps role/contentHash/sourceHash/model/createdAt/diagnostics; `incomplete(code,message)` :207-210 wraps `blocking()` (:89-100). Evidence completeness check `missing` -> `incomplete("evidence",...)` at review-layer.ts:~398-405.
- Aggregation: `aggregateReviews(results)` review-layer.ts:132-155 — dedupes findings by JSON, sorts blocking first, keeps first failure, caps findings at 12, uniqueBatches, sums diagnostics, status pass only if every result passes. `runReviewPass` returns `roles.map(role => aggregateReviews(list))` (review-layer.ts:~545-553).

=== 3. HASH + IDENTITY ===
- `lessonHash(s)` = sha256 of CRLF-normalized trimmed text (lesson.ts:20).
- `learnReviewHash(section)` = lessonHash(JSON of id, page scope, objectives, objectiveChecks, requiredChecks, synthesis, keyPoints, misconceptions, [entry.id, markdown, lesson] pairs, snapshots, figureCoverage, coverage) — lesson.ts:250-255; review receipts themselves are excluded.
- `commitHash` = lessonHash(JSON of id, objectives, objectiveChecks, [entry.id, lesson], learnReviewHash) lesson.ts:246-249; stored in `section.lessonCommit.contentHash` (:292).
- Lesson unit receipt `LessonReceipt.contentHash`/`sourceHash` lesson.ts:14 set by saveLesson/patchLesson.
- Receipt stores `contentHash` + `sourceHash` + `model` learn-quality.ts:167-172; `earnedDelivery = {sourceHash, objectiveHash}` types.ts:191 / domain.ts:231-233 (objectiveHash = lessonObjectiveHash, lesson.ts:271-273).
- Nesting: Learn `section.learnQuality.reviews` (types.ts:188); Tutor `tutor.review.receipts` (types.ts:318); Exam `exam.review.receipts` (types.ts:302); checkpoints are ordinary receipts inside the same arrays.
- Matching to a revision: `reviewGateIssues` requires latest receipt (by createdAt desc) `contentHash===context.contentHash && sourceHash===context.sourceHash` (learn-quality.ts:387-405); `reviewPassIssues` uses newest per role filtered to current `sourceHash` (learn-quality.ts:330-360); reuse in `reviewLearnDraft` :186-193; per-packet cache key is `lessonHash(JSON.stringify(["learn-review-v4", role, instructions, modelName, thinkingLevel, sourceHash, instruction, reads, views, crops, payload]))` (review-layer.ts:~445-455). Finding key: sha256(`${role}\0${target}\0${issue}`).slice(0,12) (learn-quality.ts:180-182).

=== 4. CHECKPOINT / REUSE ===
- Shape: `reviewCheckpoint(...)` learn-review.ts:166-169 = blocking(REVIEW_CHECKPOINT_MESSAGE) + role + contentHash=learnReviewHash(section) + sourceHash + model + createdAt + `failure:{code:"cancelled", message:REVIEW_CHECKPOINT_MESSAGE}` + `batches:uniqueBatches(batches)`. Message constant review-layer.ts:80. Never approval.
- Written: `saveReviewCheckpoints` tool-controller.ts:196-210 via `mutateBook` (write closure :199-206, guarded on activation/authority/source hash and `learnQuality` presence), debounced chain, `close()` drains before the approval write (:211). Wired at :786-788 and consumed through `runReviewPass` `onCheckpoint` (review-layer.ts:~440 callback in `settle`).
- Read/reused: `runReviewPass` seeds `cache` from `existingReviews` batches with `sourceHash===sourceHash && model===modelName` (review-layer.ts:~458-463); cached packet -> settle pass with the cached batch. `reviewLearnDraft` reuses whole roles whose `reviewGateIssues` is empty (:186-193).
- `pruneReviewReceipts(receipts,{sourceHash,model})` learn-quality.ts:295-312: drops other source/model; per `role:contentHash` keeps newest overall + newest completed; a `cancelled` checkpoint is dropped once that group has a completed check.

=== 5. DEADLINES / LIMITS ===
- NO 12-minute shared deadline and NO 20-minute total work limit in code. README:56 and docs/architecture.md:45 state "There is no wall-clock stop on preparation ... the only clock is the bounded reviewer run itself". README:97-101 (12-minute/20-minute) is stale 0.6.0 text. `lastProgressAt` (:150,555,570,1031) is display-only.
- Live wall-clock: `REVIEW_BACKSTOP_MS = 45*60_000` (review-runtime.ts:51) = `DEFAULT_REVIEWER_LIMITS.timeoutMs` (:66); passed as `reviewTimeoutMs` at tool-controller.ts:785 -> shared `deadlineAt = Date.now()+timeoutMs` in reviewLearnDraft (learn-review.ts:178-179); per-packet `remainingMs = deadlineAt-now` (review-layer.ts:214-217) and `timeoutMs: Math.min(DEFAULT_REVIEWER_LIMITS.timeoutMs, remainingMs)` in reviewOne limits (review-layer.ts:~419-421).
- `REVIEW_STALL_MS = 180_000` (review-runtime.ts:50) — stream-stall watchdog, used at :294 and :330 (resets per event).
- Reviewer run limits review-runtime.ts:53-67: maxTurns 2, maxToolCalls 8, maxPromptChars 180k, maxToolTextChars 40k, maxImages 8, maxImageBytes 8MiB, maxTotalImageBytes 64MiB, maxOutputTokens 4k, maxTotalOutputTokens 8k, maxResponseChars 360k. Context/output preflight :271-279; configuredLimits validates :122-131.
- Concurrency: `REVIEW_CONCURRENCY = 12` review-layer.ts:76 (worker pool `Math.min(REVIEW_CONCURRENCY, packets.length)`).
- Count rails: `MAX_PREREVIEW_REJECTIONS = 4` tool-controller.ts:87 used :757-763; 8 consecutive retry/error tones -> stop (:546-551); 250 actions -> stop (:563-566); per-packet retry once (review-layer.ts:527-529); `completedPasses`/`passCompleted` per target key (:141-143) is the one-pass latch; `prereviewRejections` (:145). Reset only by `resetTransientState` (:1023-1035).
- Transport/subprocess safety timeouts that MUST be preserved: the reviewer wall timeout + abortable wrapper (review-runtime.ts:170-235), the stall timer (:288-296, 321-333), `requestOptions {timeoutMs: limits.timeoutMs, maxRetries: 0, transport:"sse"}` (:286), registry auth abortable (:286-305), and `cleanupSessionResources` in finally (:468-472).

=== 6. DELIVERY GATE PREDICATES ===
- Primary gate `reviewPassIssues(value, {contentHash, sourceHash, roles, responses})` learn-quality.ts:330-360. Precondition `reviewGateIssues` (:387-405) with the SAME roles/hashes: any role with no receipt -> "Complete the X review"; equal-createdAt divergent receipts -> "conflicting receipts; run a fresh review"; latest contentHash/sourceHash mismatch -> "stale"; `latest.failure` -> "Complete the X review (code)"; `status!=="pass"` -> "Repair the blocking X findings". If the gate passes cleanly, reviewPassIssues returns [] (approve). Otherwise: newest receipt per role for the current sourceHash; blocking findings are listed unless answered by a `responses[].key` matching computeFindingKey; if any latest receipt has `failure`, returns [] (an unfinished check approves when it found nothing blocking); otherwise a latest receipt whose contentHash is not the current one -> stale issue. Receipts are matched to the revision by contentHash/sourceHash (see 3).
- Roles per mode: Learn `["source","teaching","visual"]` via `learnReviewIssues` lesson.ts:266-271 (called by commitLesson :289 and lessonReady :302); Tutor `["teaching"]` with `contentHash = lessonHash(markdown)` tool-controller.ts:701-703; Exam `["assessment","teaching"]` with `contentHash = examFormFingerprint` (:868-869 actually examGaps at :865-869); questions via reviewTargetQuestion -> pass requires status pass (review-layer.ts:640-652).
- Reused/pending/failed semantics: reused receipt = newest per role, consumed without re-running (:762-782 fast path); `pending` is impossible to observe because the crew is awaited inside the call; failed/missing is a gate issue; a checkpoint (failure.code "cancelled") is never approval (learn-review.ts:166-169, test verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs:412).
- `lessonReady` lesson.ts:295-304 additionally accepts `learnQuality.earnedDelivery` (sourceHash+objectiveHash) as a completed-delivery shortcut.

=== 7. AUTHOR-VISIBLE FEEDBACK + ASYNC APPEND MECHANISMS ===
- Everything model-visible is returned tool-result content. Findings are appended to the SAME result: Tutor `result.content.push` list (`role / severity / [F-<key>] / target / PDF pages: issue\nRepair: ...`) tool-controller.ts:737-748; Learn :807-819; Exam :904-914. Summary strings :777,803-805,822. Thrown errors are converted to `toolResult(action, "Scholar review|error|retry: msg", {tone})` at :974-982. `status` appends `learnQuality` JSON incl. `reviews` (batches reduced to count) :946-948.
- Mechanisms to put async-completed text into a LATER tool result in the same turn:
  (a) Persisted state read by the next tool call: the `status` action merges `quality.reviews` into a later result (:947-948) — the only path where a later result in the same turn carries earlier async review output.
  (b) `stopDelivery` sticky latch (:155-165): sets `stoppedDelivery` and aborts live reviewStops; every later non-status action throws that message (:562) -> surfaced as an error result. Async outcome therefore changes later tool results.
  (c) `ports.onReviewOutcome` / `ctx.ui.notify` / `ctx.ui.setStatus` (:159-160; runtime-coordinator.ts:395-399) are display-only, never model context.
  (d) `pi.sendMessage({customType, content, display}, {triggerTurn})` (runtime-coordinator.ts:537-540, 600-603) injects a session message (used for kickoff) — available injection point; `pi.sendUserMessage` is stubbed in tests (verify-scholar-input-lock.mjs:261).
  (e) Inbound steering arrives via `pi.on("input")` with `streamingBehavior: "steer"|"followUp"` (tests/verify-scholar-input-lock.mjs:539,718) but is swallowed during an active Scholar turn (index.ts:146-159, returns `{action:"handled"}`); editor lock routes Esc/app.interrupt to `ctx.abort()` (input-lock.ts:106; index.ts:104,118; tool-controller.ts:163).
  (f) `execute`'s 4th parameter `_onUpdate` (tool-controller.ts:543) is Pi's partial/streaming tool-output channel, currently UNUSED — it updates the SAME in-flight call, not a later one.
  (g) `pi.appendEntry` writes custom session entries (session pointer, runtime-session.ts:220) — not model-visible.
- Existing example of a tool result augmented with repair instructions: the `[F-<key>]` blocks above (tool-controller.ts:737-748/807-819/904-914) and handleNotes' next-step progress text (learning.ts:190-193).
